title: calcitrapa ferox
intro: Calcitrapa ferox, commonly known as Prickly Cactus Pear, is a type of cactus native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its edible fruits, which are rich in nutrients and provide several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Calcitrapa ferox include wound healing, skin protection, and potential anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, carotenoids, and betalains. Bioactive constituents of this plant also include vitamins A and C, potassium, and dietary fiber, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
